title: A dispatch whose record_worker fails after the worker started still waits for the worker and records its exit
goal: When bl_dispatch.record_worker raises after Popen (the ledger lock refused after its wait, an OSError on the lock or the ledger), cmd_dispatch still waits for the worker and prints its exit line and session, or ends the worker, so no failure of the ledger write orphans a running worker
notes: Found by the SP-g2ssvhi2 review (S3): bl_dispatch.py:836 and :848 call record_worker inside the with block after Popen; a Refused or OSError from it propagates out of cmd_dispatch without proc.wait(), so the worker keeps running unrecorded. BG-chw4sg54 removed only the shared-temp-file FileNotFoundError.
